audio.musicOrNoteAudioReleaseRule: Independently verify original/licensed rights and exact note/rhythm before any separate audio addition; AI audio is not ground truth.

first_read.durationBasis: No clip duration in current source; lesson minutes are not clip minutes.
first_read.idempotencyRule: Same full source-derived production spec reuses one verified candidate; changed spec creates a new key. Never overwrite an accepted asset.
negativePromptAndClaimBoundary: No copied source footage, teacher likeness, institutional endorsement or unverified rights.
No fabricated anatomy, contact, load bearing, instrument string/fret/note or beat alignment.
No numerical pass angle, BPM, force, capacity, clinical safety, camera accuracy or mastery claim absent from the current source.
No harmful error exaggeration; use a diagram, freeze frame or comfortable correction.
Do not turn observation, self report or optional adaptation into required physical execution.
Show the exact supported lesson variant; observation is a valid learner option
Show the silent first-read score and equivalent text before any played example; reveal playback only after learner attempt and self notes.
